Messages.Author: Clément
Messages.Body:
Just to check a ruling made at our last tournament.

Meth A controls Kurt Strauss and a Tupdog. Meth B, A's prey, controls
Gentha Shale and Ohoyo Hopoksia.

Ohoyo Hopoksia (Bastet)
Unique werewolf with 3 life. 3 strength, 0 bleed.
When a minion you control is about to enter combat with an acting
minion, you may tap Ohoyo to cancel that combat; Ohoyo enters combat
with the acting minion instead. She gets an optional maneuver each
combat. If she has less than 3 life during your untap phase, she gains
1 life from the blood bank.

Kurt does something and is blocked by Gentha. Meth A taps Tupdog
invoking the slave rule.

We believe there is no time for B to tap Ohoyo, since combat between
the acting (Kurt) and the blocking (Gentha) minion is immediately
replaced by a combat between Tupdog (who is not the acting minion) and
the blocking minion.

Looks straightforward, but I wanted to ask just to be 100% sure.

Abraço,

Luiz Mello

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Right. The slave rule and Ohoyo's special share the same timing window. And the
acting Methuselah gets the first chance to use an effect.
